body: BSides Hampton Roads is next week. The region's community-driven cybersecurity conference runs Friday and Saturday, October 9–10, at ODU's Webb University Center — two days of talks and hallway conversations with security professionals, students, researchers, and anyone curious about the field. If you haven't grabbed a ticket yet, now's the time: register for BSides Hampton Roads.
Warm up this week at ISSA Hampton Roads' Cybersecurity Social on Wednesday evening at The Casual Pint in Virginia Beach — a good chance to meet a few people before the conference.
Still ahead: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Hampton x RevolutionVA on Saturday, October 17, at the 757 Makerspace. It's free, open to all ages, and focused on open-source AI — register on the MLH event page.
We are always looking for topic and speaker suggestions — let us know if you have thoughts! Just hit reply, or come find us in Slack or Discord.
